title: Same model, up to rounding
heading: A Fast Builder Is Correct Only If Its Exported Model Equals the Slow One's
cases: two models built in different orders are the same, and a changed coefficient makes them differ
coefficients that differ only by rounding count as equal, and a real difference does not
a term present in one model's row and absent from the other's is a difference
a variable that is integer in one model and continuous in the other is a difference
maximizing and minimizing the same expression are different models
a row whose bound differs is a difference
